title: Petition style changes with AI writing support but outcomes do not improve
title_zh: 在AI写作支持下请愿风格改变但结果不提升
abstract: In 2023, Change.org introduced an artificial intelligence (AI)-supported petition-drafting tool to their platform. With access to this tool, users’ petitions changed substantially, and their texts became more similar to one another. At the same time, overall petition outcomes did not improve, which shows the limits of AI integration into online advocacy communities.
abstract_zh: 2023年，Change.org在其平台上引入了一个人工智能（AI）辅助的请愿草稿工具。在使用该工具的情况下，用户的请愿书发生了实质性变化，其文本相互之间变得更加相似。与此同时，总体请愿结果并未提升，这展示了AI整合到在线倡导社区的局限性。
